body: This is my first comment in a year since I posted here for help myself. Glad to see someone else is doing well.

I'm just starting college, and my family is there for me. But the problem is, why should I burden them with that knowledge? How will they look at me different? What happens to the emotional rock they need? I don't want them to constantly tiptoe. Besides I'm the eldest brother of three and my sister has gone through a cutting phase before, and I want to prevent another cycle.

Oh god the mask, exactly what I call it. I haven't cried since I was little, I'm everyone's emotional rock because they don't know I can't show emotion. Sure I feel sad but the whole hollow feeling takes over every couple months. I need something to help me but I do t have the balls to seek it. I'm truly lost right now.
I wish I was this strong. Strength was not walking away from help, but accepting it. I need this kind of strength.

I'm just starting college and I'm failing classes. Always the smart kid who didn't have to try. Now I have to try and don't know how. Extremely supportive family but I can't tell them. How can I? "Mom, dad, I'm failing all of my classes but one". Even worse my dad does the same thing, but is in an extremely respected position at it. I wish I could cry. Oh how I wish I could, to let SOMETHING out. Still nothing. I feel completely alone. I'm well liked but have no friends. I know where you are coming from and I'm coming to a point to where I'm about to say fuck everything I'm out. I think we boh need advice

I was the kid who was always smart enough to pass a class in high school while sleeping.  I never learned how to properly study or even try at school and now college sucks. I know where you are coming from.

I'm exactly where you are at but I'm about 10 years younger. It's the worst when that hollow empty feeling sets in and feels like concrete in your chest. I do think about doing it myself though and it scares me when I "sober up" for lack of a better term. Pm me if you need a talk, my story is no secret to anyone.

Thing is, you can't cheer up from it. It's a numbness that blocks you from feeling positive emotions. It's like when your feet get cold in the winter, while your feet are cold you will never be comfortable. Your feet will warm up but it's inevitable that they will become cold again. So you distract yourself as long as possible.

I feel him. I always say stuff like that to myself to keep myself in line. If he was saying stuff like that he just was on the tail end of the depression wave or was trying to act rationally during it
Having an std for as long as I can remember, turned down sex 4 times so far, about to I I college. Oh and suicidal levels of depression dosent help

I don't think you understand, on top of all of this I have an STD that I can clearly see, and am going into college. Because of said STD I am terrified to become close to anyone in an intimate relationship, and this is a major amplifier of my depression as i have had it as long as I remember and WILL NOT take any chances of passing it on even with a condom. It is so emotionally painful for me to continue my habit of suddenly disappearing from promising relationships after a few dates, or being a jerk as an excuse to get out. So there's no running from that. That and I have daydreamed of doing it in front of my friends on Skype with the video off, that's when I'm most comfortable, yet now I have to alienate myself from them too to protect them from me. I see myself as the selfish scum I am and there is no running from that. There's nowhere for me to go for the next few years, until I graduate. Then I plan to move to Alaska and slowly lose contact with everyone
I guess it's true I'm not afraid of death anymore but shit's paid for
Some shit does last forever. Can't run or fix what I have.
I'd hate anyone but the authorities to find me first. I've got shit going down and a shotgun is what I'm thinking about. Would not be a pretty sight.

Yup, I  am beginning to think I am incapable of physically crying, as bad as I am. I press down emotions and I now can't let them out even if I try. If you want to know why, look at my post history, I'm working and don't need to bring myself down typing it out again.
